rongmei.title: He kandi khou bam san khou hei

lines: 1. He kandih khou bam san khouhei,
Rianramei rui gum liamme;
Theimei Jordan dui kan mak san khou,
Poubaumei rui lung geic na bamv e.
He tithai lou o damlou pui ram,
Zianmei le kau latdiw bam ntammak pui ram;
Kandih rianra ram pat louna,
He tabui nung rui guang tang ni cho?
2. Rei khou rianrana bam mei guai,
Kagun daipui ram tang khou;
Tatrei mei le bumang thanmei guai rui,
He nzanegmei Guangc ta thuan ku e.
3. Ka tingsang lu suan cham khang tei,
Kao e nthanmei nun rui;
Kakhuan gaimei tei chulana ai,
Hei ram gaimei tei ninga kap be.
4. Ningtan makge Immanuel,
Damthanmei Jerusalem;
Kandih hei rianra pui ram dai e,
Tang lak ni the pinge zailou o.
